lines.title: Understanding the organization and its context
lines.testFocus: Internal and external issues affecting the service management system are identified.

lines.title: Needs and expectations of interested parties
lines.testFocus: Customers, users, suppliers and other interested parties and their requirements are identified.

lines.title: Determining the scope of the SMS
lines.testFocus: Scope states the services, the organizational units and the geography; exclusions are justified.

lines.title: Service management system
lines.testFocus: The SMS is established, implemented, maintained and continually improved.

lines.title: Leadership and commitment
lines.testFocus: Top management is accountable for the SMS, sets direction and provides resources.

lines.title: Policy
lines.testFocus: A service management policy exists, is appropriate to the purpose, and is communicated.

lines.title: Organizational roles, responsibilities and authorities
lines.testFocus: Roles for the SMS and for each service management process are assigned and understood.

lines.title: Actions to address risks and opportunities
lines.testFocus: Risks to the services and to the SMS are determined, and actions planned and evaluated.

lines.title: Service management objectives and planning
lines.testFocus: Objectives are measurable, consistent with the policy, monitored and communicated.

lines.title: Plan the SMS
lines.testFocus: A service management plan exists covering services, processes, resources, interfaces and timescales.

lines.title: Resources
lines.testFocus: Human, technical, information and financial resources for the SMS are determined and provided.

lines.title: Competence
lines.testFocus: Competence needs are defined, staff are competent, and evidence is retained.

lines.title: Awareness
lines.testFocus: People are aware of the policy, objectives, their contribution and the consequences of not conforming.

lines.title: Communication
lines.testFocus: Internal and external communication relevant to the SMS is determined and carried out.

lines.title: Documented information - general
lines.testFocus: The SMS includes the documented information required and that needed for effectiveness.

lines.title: Creating and updating documented information
lines.testFocus: Identification, format, review and approval of documents is controlled.

lines.title: Control of documented information
lines.testFocus: Availability, protection, version control, retention and disposal are controlled.

lines.title: Service management system documented information
lines.testFocus: The specific records the standard requires - plans, catalogue, SLAs, procedures - are present.

lines.title: Knowledge
lines.testFocus: Knowledge needed for the operation of the services and the SMS is determined, maintained and available.

lines.title: Operational planning and control
lines.testFocus: Processes are planned, implemented, controlled and their criteria defined; outsourced processes controlled.

lines.title: Service delivery
lines.testFocus: Services delivered match the agreed scope; the organization retains accountability even where delegated.
lines.evidenceLives: Gap Assessment · Service catalogue · Asset register

lines.title: Plan the services
lines.testFocus: New or changed services are planned including requirements, resources, timescales and acceptance criteria.
lines.evidenceLives: Gap Assessment · Service catalogue · Asset register

lines.title: Control of parties involved in the service lifecycle
lines.testFocus: Internal groups, customers acting as suppliers and external suppliers are identified and governed.
lines.evidenceLives: Gap Assessment · Service catalogue · Asset register

lines.title: Service catalogue management
lines.testFocus: A service catalogue is created, maintained and made available to the relevant parties.
lines.evidenceLives: Gap Assessment · Service catalogue · Asset register

lines.title: Asset management
lines.testFocus: Assets used to deliver services are managed to meet service requirements and obligations.
lines.evidenceLives: Gap Assessment · Service catalogue · Asset register

lines.title: Configuration management
lines.testFocus: CIs are defined, recorded, controlled, verified and the CMDB is accurate.
lines.evidenceLives: Gap Assessment · Service catalogue · Asset register

lines.title: General
lines.testFocus: Interested parties, services and the parties delivering them are identified and documented.
lines.evidenceLives: Gap Assessment · Supplier records · SLA library

lines.title: Business relationship management
lines.testFocus: A named contact, a communication mechanism, customer satisfaction measurement and complaints handling.
lines.evidenceLives: Gap Assessment · Supplier records · SLA library

lines.title: Service level management
lines.testFocus: Services have SLAs with targets and workload characteristics; performance is monitored and reviewed.
lines.evidenceLives: Gap Assessment · Supplier records · SLA library

lines.title: Management of external suppliers
lines.testFocus: Documented agreements, defined interfaces, performance monitoring and dispute handling.
lines.evidenceLives: Gap Assessment · Supplier records · SLA library

lines.title: Management of internal suppliers and customers acting as suppliers
lines.testFocus: Documented agreements with internal groups, and performance monitored on the same basis.
lines.evidenceLives: Gap Assessment · Supplier records · SLA library

lines.title: Budgeting and accounting for services
lines.testFocus: Costs are budgeted, tracked against budget and reported; cost of services can be evidenced.
lines.evidenceLives: Gap Assessment · Capacity and budget records

lines.title: Demand management
lines.testFocus: Current and forecast demand is determined and monitored, and capacity influenced accordingly.
lines.evidenceLives: Gap Assessment · Capacity and budget records

lines.title: Capacity management
lines.testFocus: Capacity requirements are determined, resources planned, and capacity monitored against requirements.
lines.evidenceLives: Gap Assessment · Capacity and budget records

lines.title: Change management
lines.testFocus: Change policy, recording, assessment, approval, scheduling and post-implementation review.

lines.title: Service design and transition
lines.testFocus: New or changed services are designed, built and tested against documented requirements before release.

lines.title: Release and deployment management
lines.testFocus: Release policy, controlled deployment into live, verification of success and rollback where needed.

lines.title: Incident management
lines.testFocus: Recording, classification, prioritisation, escalation, resolution and closure; major incidents defined.
lines.evidenceLives: Gap Assessment · Incident and problem records

lines.title: Service request management
lines.testFocus: Requests are recorded, classified, prioritised, fulfilled and closed against documented criteria.
lines.evidenceLives: Gap Assessment · Incident and problem records

lines.title: Problem management
lines.testFocus: Problems identified from incident trends, root cause analysed, known errors recorded, actions tracked.
lines.evidenceLives: Gap Assessment · Incident and problem records

lines.title: Service availability management
lines.testFocus: Availability requirements and targets are determined, monitored and results acted on.
lines.evidenceLives: BCMS (continuity) · IS Risk Register (security) · Availability records

lines.title: Service continuity management
lines.testFocus: Continuity requirements, plans, and testing at planned intervals with results recorded.
lines.evidenceLives: BCMS (continuity) · IS Risk Register (security) · Availability records

lines.title: Information security management
lines.testFocus: Security policy applied to services, controls implemented, incidents managed, external obligations met.
lines.evidenceLives: BCMS (continuity) · IS Risk Register (security) · Availability records

lines.title: Monitoring, measurement, analysis and evaluation
lines.testFocus: What is monitored, method, when and by whom; results evaluated and retained.

lines.title: Internal audit
lines.testFocus: Audit programme at planned intervals; auditors objective and impartial; results reported to management.

lines.title: Management review
lines.testFocus: Top management review at planned intervals with the required inputs and recorded decisions.

lines.title: Service reporting
lines.testFocus: Reports are produced on service performance, against agreed description, frequency and audience.

lines.title: Nonconformity and corrective action
lines.testFocus: Nonconformities reacted to, root cause established, action taken, effectiveness reviewed, records kept.

lines.title: Continual improvement
lines.testFocus: Improvement opportunities identified, evaluated against criteria, actioned and their results measured.
